goodToKnow: Das Vieh is livestock, especially cattle, as a collective noun with no plural: das Vieh füttern, die Viehzucht (cattle breeding). In the Alps, der Almabtrieb or Viehscheid in autumn is a festival when decorated cows come down from the summer pastures. As an insult, Du Vieh! means you brute, and viehisch means bestial. The h is silent: FEE. Related to English fee, since cattle once meant wealth.
